about_the_game:
STORY

The end of the world is nigh, the dark forces of the world have gained more and more control in the past years. This is the culmination point, a point of no return. The Dark Lord has finally set his final plan into motion, and there is no one stopping him.

His minions roam the wilderness and soon will launch an attack onto every inhabited area of the lands. Is there no way to prevent this?

The world has given up hope, with just mere weeks left to live the people have made peace with their fates. A decision to live out their lives away from fear, living their normal lives, trying to pretend nothing is happening. A small group of friends set out one late evening to camp out in a nearby cave. Why?

To get drunk and party one last time and enjoy the night, together. Yet when they woke up they felt different, they felt special!

The ancient cave granted them abilities to challenge the rule of the Dark Lord. Could this group of cowards become the Lords undoing? Was this gift a blessing from a godlike entity, a miracle, or just another one of the Dark Lords games?

This is where your story begins…

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------





Support the Game by Wish listing!
Wish listing has a huge impact on helping the game grow and reach more players. Each Wishlist not only shows support for the project but also directly helps us continue development, gather feedback, and make this chaotic multiplayer roguelike even better.

Thank you for helping us bring Play With Friends to life!





💀 Rogue-like Chaos Meets PS1 Nostalgia

Play With Friends is a retro-style, co-op rogue-like adventure where death actually matters — if you die, you restart.
Each run is different: explore random dungeons, complete bizarre quests, loot chaotic items, and laugh your way through the apocalypse with your friends (if you have any). (5-Players)

Earn coins and experience to unlock permanent upgrades, cosmetics, and career rewards between runs.
Or just emote, troll, and mess around in proximity chat until someone ruins everything.(SET EVERYONE ON FIRE)

🏕️ Core Features

  • Multiplayer Co-op: Jump in with friends for chaotic adventures, quests, and shenanigans.

  • True Rogue-like Gameplay: Die and lose everything — except what you’ve banked.

  • Bank System & Shop: Save your hard-earned money to buy permanent buffs, cosmetics, and upgrades.

  • Career Progression: Level up to unlock random items, bonuses, and rewards over time.

  • Randomized Dungeons & Quests: Every session is different — new layouts, enemies, loot, and surprises.

  • Map Shops: Temporary items for that run only — pick wisely or waste it all on junk.

  • Trophy System: Earn achievements and proudly display them in your personal Trophy Case.

  • Proximity Voice Chat: Shout, laugh, or cry in retro PS1 glory.

  • Stylized PS1 Aesthetic: Low-poly, cartoon chaos inspired by late-90s classics.

  • Party Game Energy: It’s not about winning — it’s about what ridiculous thing happens next.

🌍 A Retro Party Rogue-like to Play With Friends

Survive the end of the world, grow stronger, and prove you’re more than just a group of drunk cave friends.
Or, you know, just dance on your enemies. Either way, you’ll have a good time.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Dev Note:

This game is being lovingly crafted by two slow-but-passionate developers along side with help from others (all credited in credits of game) working on it in their spare time while balancing full-time jobs. We’re aiming for Early Access in early 2026, but who knows—development may take longer as we perfect the game!

If the game receives positive support, it will allow us to work on it full-time, speeding up development and delivering updates even faster. As we get closer to early 2026, we’ll share regular updates, so nothing will be held back and you’ll know exactly when the game is coming. All progression and new features will be shared on the Steam store page, with additional insights, screenshots, and behind-the-scenes content on Instagram and Discord.

We’re excited to build this chaotic multiplayer roguelike together with the community and make it the best it can be!





Thank you for being awesome!

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains mild cartoon-style combat and light-hearted references to alcohol, tobacco, and fictional “drug” items used as gameplay buffs or debuffs. These items cause humorous effects such as screen wobble or temporary movement changes. There is no realistic depiction of substance use, injury, or gore. All content is presented in a comedic and stylized way.

  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: also yes

  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 250 MB available space
  • Sound Card: any
